Subject: Prostate mpMRI | Amsterdam UMC VUmc
Date: 18 Feb 2025

Clinical indication: Elevated PSA (4.5 ng/mL), follow-up evaluation.

FINDINGS: The gland measures 47.29 mL overall. Zonal architecture shows a mildly enlarged transition zone displaying uniform signal intensity. The peripheral zone maintains symmetry. T2-weighted sequences lack focal hypointensity. Diffusion-weighted imaging combined with ADC mapping demonstrates no restricted diffusion. Dynamic contrast-enhanced series are negative. A 6 mm benign-appearing focus resides in the right base peripheral zone. No suspicious focal lesion is identified. PI-RADS NA.

IMPRESSION: Prostate volume 47.29 mL. No PI-RADS 3+ lesion identified. PI-RADS NA. PSAD 0.095 ng/mL/mL. csPCa predicted probability 0.5290899

previous_notes.author: Dr. P. van Dijk (GP)
previous_notes.text: Dr. P. van Dijk documented the PSA increase from 3.0 ng/mL in November 2023 to 4.1 ng/mL by July 2024. Noting the upward trend and the patient’s stated reluctance toward invasive testing, an mpMRI was scheduled to clarify the rising biomarker values.
